🎥🎬: Twisted Metal (2023)
In a world destroyed by chaos, John Doe makes a living delivering packages across a dangerous wasteland filled with violent outlaws and deadly drivers. When he’s offered a chance at a better life, he must complete a dangerous mission that pushes him into the most unpredictable corners of this broken world.
His journey brings him face-to-face with Sweet Tooth, a masked maniac whose weaponized ice cream truck is just as terrifying as his personality. Between ruthless enemies and high-speed confrontations, surviving the journey becomes a challenge of its own.
With outrageous characters, explosive vehicle battles, and twisted humour, Twisted Metal delivers an action-packed ride where the road to a better future is paved with destruction.
Twisted Metal is now streaming on Peacock. #SonyPicsPartner
